entries.en: Narujj Boh asks that you try your hand at organ harvesting.

entries.en: Evidently forewarned by the drakes and their contented purring, Narujj Boh thanks you for your efforts before you have even had a chance to report your success. The Brotherhood warrior appears eager to witness the fiery results of the drakes' grisly meal.
entries.fr: Narujj Boh s'est montré satisfait de la réussite de votre expédition. Continuez à lui venir en aide à l'avenir.
entries.ja: ナルジ・ボーに報告した。彼は冒険者の働きぶりに感服し、深く感謝しているようだ。またの機会に協力しよう。

entries.en: Compared to the seething ranks of the Flamefangs, the Brotherhood of Ash is a small force indeed. Thus must we seek to attain the pinnacle of strength if we are to triumph against our foe's numerical advantage.
entries.fr: Comparés à nos ennemis, peu nombreux nous sommes. La prouesse au combat, nous devons d'autant plus rechercher. Compenser notre nombre, il nous faut.
entries.ja:
「炎牙衆」に比べ、我ら「灰の一党」は。
ゆえに少数精鋭を目指さねばならない。

entries.en: It is not a matter of merely honing our martial prowess─equal consideration and effort must be afforded our weapons, as well as our mounts.
entries.fr: Une bonne manière d'améliorer son efficacité au combat, fortifier son draconide de combat est. Un puissant guerrier, une puissante monture fait.
entries.ja:
武人として己の腕を磨くのみならず、
刃を研ぎ、騎乗するドレイクを育成するのもまた
戦に向かうためには重要なこと。
